reference.note: The local .local snapshot remains alpha.1 and was not edited or used as the alpha.3 runtime. Alpha.3 source audit used an external cleanable checkout.

upstreamReview.runtimeDecision: alpha.3 is the sole alpha-branch development runtime. The official 244-package npm family is exact-version and integrity pinned; the alpha.1 source-artifact selector is retired, not retained as a compatibility path.
upstreamReview.ownershipImpact: Agent hooks, llm/stream, tools/pre-execute, shipped standard preset, Inspector eventSource and AppFrame/details seams remain compatible. Alpha.3 makes Session projections mandatory for Agent, usage and Subagent state; converges unary Remote calls on RemoteResult/RemoteError; adds SessionEvent.ignorable for unknown external events; keeps JSONL persistence; expands history load-through pagination; and tightens cancel/Subagent projection behavior. Aezy consumes these owners without copying their kernels.
